core.title: Copper Kettle curfew
core.setting: The theatre stage manager at Littlewick Playhouse whose assistant keeps rehearsal schedules, cue sheets, and cast availability

events.text: Standing rule on spending: any supplier order or freelance hire above 400 pounds needs written sign-off from Priya Nair, our finance lead, before it is confirmed. Anything at or below 400 pounds can go ahead without her.
Autumn production confirmed: 'The Copper Kettle', playing the Main House. Tech run and dress rehearsal will land in late October, with the opening at the end of the month.
Just to confirm staffing: Colin Fenn runs the Green Room bar on show nights and tech nights this season. He is our regular steward and knows the till and the cellar.

House rules for the building, effective now. The Main House has an evening noise curfew of 23:00. The Studio has no curfew. Any Main House booking that needs to run past the curfew requires my prior agreement. The Green Room bar closes one hour after curfew. Confirmed bookings may only be moved to a different date or space with my agreement.
We would love to hire the Main House for our autumn concert on 15 November, an afternoon slot. Roughly 60 singers and an audience of about 120. Could you hold it for us?
Read-through for 'The Copper Kettle' booked in the Green Room on 3 September at 18:30, full cast. Confirmed in the diary.
Quote for your autumn props consumables box: 260 pounds including delivery of tape, rope, Velcro, and sundries to the Main House lighting store.
Props consumables ordered from Halden Theatrical Supplies at 260 pounds. That is below the 400 pound sign-off threshold, so Priya Nair's approval is not needed. Order placed.
To confirm terms: a 14:00 start on 15 November, finishing by 17:30, and our usual hire fee of 600 pounds for the afternoon.
The Littlewick Choral Society's autumn concert is confirmed in the Main House on 15 November, 14:00 to 17:30, fee 600 pounds, contact Ruth Okafor. Booking confirmed.
Cast availability for blocking is best on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. Everyone has kept those free through the autumn.

Blocking rehearsals for 'The Copper Kettle' will run in the Studio on Tuesday and Thursday evenings, 19:00 to 23:00. The Studio has no curfew under the July house rules, so we can work late there without any special agreement. Series booked and confirmed in the diary.

Season reminder of the house rules: the Main House falls quiet at 23:00, the Green Room bar closes at midnight, one hour after curfew, and the Studio has no curfew. Any Main House booking running past 23:00 needs Marcus's agreement.
Read-through minutes: full cast attended, the Green Room worked well, and the first blocking call is set for next Tuesday.
Sam Reddy is booked as freelance followspot operator for 'The Copper Kettle' at 140 pounds a night, covering the tech run and the dress rehearsal.
Production dates are locked: tech run on 22 October, dress rehearsal on 26 October, opening night on 30 October. All in the Main House.

Tech run for 'The Copper Kettle' booked in the Main House on Thursday 22 October, 19:00 to 23:00. It finishes exactly at the Main House curfew of 23:00, so no special agreement from Marcus is needed under the house rules. Confirmed in the diary with Sam Reddy on the followspot.
Happy to steward the Green Room bar on the tech night on the 22nd, as usual. Just let me know what time we are closing and I will sort myself a taxi home.

Bar arrangements for the tech night on 22 October: Colin Fenn will steward the Green Room bar, closing at midnight, since the house rules have the bar close one hour after the 23:00 Main House curfew. Booked in the schedule.
Night taxi booked with Littlewick Cars for Colin Fenn after the tech-night bar closes at midnight: pickup at 00:15 on 22 October at the Main House stage door.
For the concert we would need about 250 printed programmes. Can the theatre handle that through your usual printer?

Concert programmes ordered from Rowan Print: 250 copies at 310 pounds, delivering to the front-of-house desk before 15 November. Below the 400 pound threshold, so no finance sign-off is needed. Order confirmed.
Tech-night plan as booked: the run goes 19:00 to 23:00 in the Main House, the Green Room bar is open with Colin until midnight, and his taxi is called for 00:15 at the stage door. All set.

Team, I have had a formal noise complaint from the flats on Weaver Lane about noise carrying from the Main House late at night. From Monday 12 October the Main House must be quiet by 21:30 instead of 23:00. This replaces the July house rules on the curfew: the Studio still has no curfew, moving a confirmed booking to another date or space still needs my agreement, and any Main House booking that has to run past 21:30 now needs my prior sign-off. The Green Room bar closes one hour after curfew, so midnight bar finishes are gone. Please look at everything in the diary for the Main House after 21:30 from the 12th onwards.

For the cast party after the dress rehearsal on the 26th, could the bar stay open till midnight? Colin says he is happy to stay late if we book him another taxi. Let's give the cast a proper send-off before opening night.
Dress rehearsal for 'The Copper Kettle' booked in the Main House on 26 October, 18:30 to 21:15, comfortably inside the new 21:30 quiet time, so no late agreement is needed. Confirmed in the diary.
Perfect, 14:00 start on the 15th works for us. We will bring our own piano accompanist.
Interval drinks for opening night ordered from Bramble Wines: 24 bottles at 300 pounds, delivering to the Green Room bar before 30 October. Below the 400 pound sign-off threshold. Order placed.
Confirming I am free for both the tech run on the 22nd and the dress on the 26th. I will bring my own headset.
Production meeting notes: cue sheets for Act One are with lighting, props list is nearly final, and the choral society concert crew is confirmed for the 15th.
To do before tech week: confirm the final running order with Marcus by 21 October.
Nadia, what time should I tell the taxi firm for the tech night on the 22nd? And when do we close the bar that evening? I want to get home at a sensible hour.
Called to say the props consumables invoice has been issued and the autumn restock list is ready whenever you need it.
